name: document_transformation_suite
task: A deterministic document-transformation pipeline no longer produces its reference digests. Trace the data transformations and repair every root cause. Range folds must include both endpoints of their requested window, and whole-buffer digests must incorporate each element with its zero-based position exactly once. Preserve public interfaces, pipeline order, configuration values, and unrelated arithmetic. Build the project; an independent evaluator will verify the complete correctness suite.
